content: We've used Dancing Cubs for two projects at our Museum now and they have been fabulous throughout. Professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with all round. Could not recommend enough.

We used Dancing Cubs for our community event, everything from the email exchanges to on day delivery ran so smoothly, they were on time, efficient and delivered without a hitch. Really helped us put on the best event for the dogs.
We have used the wonderful people at Dancing Cubs twice now and they have been superb. Great products, lovely people, and value for money. Thank you so much to the whole team!

We had a fantastic experience with Dancing Cubs providing soft play for our event over the weekend. Everything ran smoothly and the day was a big success. All prior communication was great, delivery was excellent, setup was done brilliantly, and the team were very efficient and helpful. The equipment was also high quality. Overall, a very high level of service and a great product – I would definitely recommend them.

We recently booked the soft play and celebration bouncy castle for our son’s first birthday. From the moment I first contacted Lopez at Dancing Cubs, he was so friendly and helpful. I had so many questions but he was always happy to answer them.
On the day of the party the items were delivered and set up exactly how we asked and collection was seamless.
Overall the whole experience was brilliant and could not fault them in any way. I will definitely be booking in again for future events.

Thank you so much for the wonderful soft play. My little boy had a great 1st birthday party, as did all the kids, and they were of quite differing ages! The delivery and collection was very smooth and speedy - all went to plan!
We'll definitely remember you for the next party and highly recommend!

Booked Dancing Cubs for my daughters 1st birthday party and they were unbelievable from the second I booked, they arrived ontime were polite, professional and even steam cleaned the soft play once set up. I was reassured that it was clean and the kids loved it so much, thank you will be sure to spread the word and will definitely use you again. Book Dancing Cubs with confidence.

We booked Dancing Cubs for a ball pond for a children's Halloween event at our office. The experience throughout was incredible. Zara and team are highly organised, clear at communicating to ensure access and set-up went smoothly and also came and took it away again without any issue. Would book again for children's party both at home and in our office.

Fantastic experience with Dancing Cubs. Great array of soft play options, really helpful and communicative by email, prompt with delivery and pick up and they installed it with great professionalism. Kids loved the soft play and waffle bricks. Would definitely use again and recommend. Thanks Zara and the team!

Dancing Cubs were amazing to work with. Great communciation and the luxury soft play we hired was pristine. Our kid guests spent about 6 solid hours playing with and the adults were happy too! Would use again.

The best value, well organised, efficient and friendly company!  We hired a lot of play equipment for a birthday party in East London and we were very impressed.  They delivered and picked up on time, they were very helpful and also gave us complimentary fencing to place around our soft play area.
We highly recommend and would definitely look to using them again in the future.

So thrilled with our Dancing Cubs experience! I booked the Jungle Soft Play Package and the Green and Gold Ball Pond for my son’s “Wild One” first birthday party, and we were so pleased with our rentals. Prior to the party, Zara and the team were very professional and responsive (including last minute requests from my party venue for paperwork). The crew that dropped off/set up the soft play were really friendly and helpful. Everything was very clean and in excellent condition.  And most importantly, the kids really loved playing with everything! We would definitely book again for future events!
From start to finish, it was a totally seamless experience! Very friendly delivery team as well. Kids loved it! We got the jungle soft play kit x

Excellent service. The party we held was a huge success. The children LOVED all the play equipment, they really had a ball. I thought that you at Dancing Cubs were highly professional from beginning to end. Your staff who delivered the play equipment were prompt, polite and pleasant to deal with and all the play equipment was very clean. Overall we were delighted. I will definitely be recommending your company to my friends for future events.
Really professional company and really good quality material. Everything was really clean and made my whole party much more fun! Would highly recommend Dancing Cubs for children parties!

Dancing Cubs were fantastic. They were easy to deal with and answered all of my questions. On the day of the party both the delivery and pick up of the soft play and tables/chairs was quick and efficient. The delivery men were super friendly and helpful. Regarding the equipment itself, everything was great quality and very well kept. The kids all had an amazing time and enjoyed all of the toys that they played with. The children's tables and chairs were incredibly cute and looked great in the room. I would definitely recommend them and would happily use them again for my next children's party.

Really delighted with the equipment and service from Dancing Cubs! We had the 2m x 2m Nature’s Own Pond ball pit with slide for my daughter’s 5th birthday, and it was a huge hit with the all the kids! They loved jumping in it and burying themselves under all the balls, as it’s so deep so quite different from a standard ball pit. Also the service on booking was great, so easy, and both delivery and collection were bang on time, and really helpful. Overall a great experience, highly recommended!

Our 1 year old's birthday party was a huge success - there were lots of happy babies and children and so lots of happy parents! The soft play went down brilliantly - many friends commented to say how great it was. It was totally stress-free for us - drop off and collection of the equipment went without a hitch. We are 100% satisfied with Dancing Cubs' service and will definitely hire again. Highly recommend.

March 2026- booked the team for my 2nd sons 1st birthday. Once again the they were amazing from booking to delivery. Prompt responses to emails! Lopez delivered and arranged everything so quickly! She was patient as there was some delay in getting into the hall. Joseph collected and also incredibly patient as we had little ones who did not want to give up the soft play bit he worked around them quickly and professionally! Highly recommend these guys to all children's parties! The kids and parents LOVED the soft play!
June 2024-Last minute booking. Spoke to the team about what I wanted, and they were super helpful! Communication via email once booked was smooth. On the day the team arrived earlier than expected, which was really appreciated! We had issues with entering our venue, and Matthew and Farouq (set up team) were understanding and patient! They were fast at setting up and ensured we knew what was needed to keep the area safe for the children. Collection was prompt also! Amazing team!! We would highly recommend them!

We hired the soft play area, Lavender package activity range for my sons first birthday party and it was amazing for the children, all ages from 1+. The children had so much fun and it was entertainment from start to finish plus it was very large so enough for all of the children to play on together. The staff were very professional and lovely when booking. Would definitely recommend and hire from Dancing Cubs again.

We had an absolute ball with the play equipment Dancing Cubs supplied - the children had a fantastic afternoon and played for 3 hours straight without stopping! The quality of the equipment was high, everything was clean and new-looking. We were so happy with everything provided and special mention goes to the amazing pair of delivery women who were quick, efficient and very cheerful! Would definitely recommend

I hired a variety of equipment for my daughters 3rd birthday. The level of service I received was excellent and all equipment soft play items were very clean.
The kids had a blast!  I will definitely be utilising Dancing Cubs if I am in need of any soft play equipment again.

First time using Dancing Cubs and found them very professional - prompt responses to emails from Zara, and they contacted us when running late so we knew when to expect the equipment. Everything was set up in time for the party starting and Matthew was a friendly and efficient delivery/pick-up driver. The deposit was returned very swiftly afterwards. Oh, and most importantly the children had lots of fun with the things we hired. Thanks!

We hired the D ball pond and the orange package for my daughter's christening/1st birthday. The staff in the office were approachable and helpful, with quick email responses to any queries we had. The delivery was on time and the set-up looked great. The condition of the soft play was immaculate, and the kids absolutely loved the party. We would highly recommend Dancing Cubs and will certainly use them again in the future!

Such a wonderful experience! Zara and her team are so communicative, professional and the kids absolutely loved the gorgeous soft play at my daughter's birthday. The crew showed up on time for drop off and pick up, found the perfect location to set up and were so friendly. Thank you for making my daughter's birthday so special!

We've ordered soft play and other toys from Dancing Cubs for our daughter's first and second birthdays and the service was immaculate both times. The kids had great fun and both parties were a success! Thank you :)

We couldn't be happier with the excellent service and equipment we hired from Dancing Cubs for our son's 3rd birthday party in our local park. We hired the Step2 rollercoaster which was a huge hit with all the kids! It was delivered and setup without any problem at all, then collected at the end of the day. Communication was excellent throughout! This is  a wonderful way of bringing something special and different to a little one's party - and hiring is much better for the environment than buying new. I would highly recommend Dancing Cubs and will definitely be using them again!

dancing cubs provided us with soft play for my little girls first birthday - it was fantastic.
They were so helpful and accommodating.
Dancing cubs turned up to our venue early and set up even putting fencing round the soft play for added security for the children.
All who attended loved it and I passed their details on to many !
Thanks again to Zara and the team!

We were mostly happy with the communication, and friendly service. Zara and Lopez are really helpful.
The ball pit itself was great! Clean, and a cool design. Our event went well, and everyone loved the ball pit. We would definitely recommend this company, and use them again ourselves!
In our evaluation the only negative, was that we had to pack up the balls from the ball pit ourselves. We didn't know this prior to delivery, and it took eight of our guests to help. (So we do appreciate why it would be difficult for one member of staff) But it was a bit of a frantic end, to a great night. And we would have factored in more time, or arranged to have more help had we known.

We hired some soft play for our daughters 3rd birthday party and our wedding and it was INCREDIBLE! The children LOVED it and it meant adults could have a nice time too. I will definitely be using them again. Great service very prompt and professional and great equipment too.

We hired some soft play equipment for a join 1-year old party (with nine babies) and all babies and parents couldn't have been happier with the experience. The set up and drop off was a dream to arrange, the equipment was fabulous and the pick up was swift (as was the return deposit).  Thank you Zara and the Dancing cubs team!!  We will remember you for future parties and definitely recommend them!

Great professional service, was no hassle for them to change the location and time for me. Perfect size bouncy castle for 1st birthday little one & friends had fun! Cannot wait to use again in the future for older birthdays! Definitely will use again! I didn’t have time to get pictures of it all set up but my little man had a fantastic time l.
Thank you Dancing cubs for outstanding service & product!

Hired a soft play theme for our sons 1st birthday. Found the staff to be informative and helpful, made the whole process easy.
Found the chaps who delivered and installed the equipment, to be friendly and knowledgeable.
Would thoroughly recommend Dancing Cubs to all. Well run organisation, with a friendly, personal touch...will come back again!
Thanks to all at Dancing Cubs!

We are so pleased with the prompt service! We recently hired a ball pit from Dancing cubs for my toddler's birthday party. The booking process was super easy, staff we spoke to were very friendly, the ball pit arrived at the party venue well in time and was set up by the supplier themselves which made things so convenient for us, giving us time to focus on other aspects of the party. We got the D shaped ball pit which was actually quite big and also surprisingly deep. The kids absolutely loved it! At the end of the party, we packed up the balls and everything was collected by the team. The deposit of £50 was also promptly returned. All in all a great service and highly recommended!

Dancing Cubs were fantastic - the soft play we hired for my son's first birthday was delivered promptly in brilliant clean condition and set up quickly. The babies all had such a great time playing on it - it really made our party!

The team were fantastic. Very professional, pleasant and communication was great. The kids enjoyed playing with the equipment  which was clean. I fully endorse hiring from Dancing Cubs, we will definitely use them again in the future.

Dancing Cubs offers an excellent range of products with fantastic customer service. Delivery and installation at our party venue was on time and staff were very friendly and helpful. We had the kiddi cars and race track-it kept 20+ 3 and 4 year olds engaged and entertained for 2 hours with not a single tantrum. Even the older children (7-11yos) loved it. Fantastic and will definitely be using again.

Lopez is extremely efficient and friendly. She delivered and picked up the equipment right on time. The soft play went down a storm with the children so very glad we hired it. Incredibly good value for high quality equipment. Will definitely be recommending Dancing Cubs in future.

We hired celebration bouncy castle and the little island pond... kids absolutely loved them both. The staff were really nice and friendly, collection time we didnt even have the balls ready (we lost track of time) as stated in the email, however the lady who came to collect was not annoyed or angry she was nice about it and we quickly tidied it all up.
Overall experience was fantastic and hope to use dancing cubs in the future. Thanks Zara

We hired the inflatable race track and the big toys package for our 3 year old's birthday party. It was awesome. Our boy and all his friends had an absolutely fab time. Thank you Dancing Cubs for creating such a memorable party for the children, especially our boy. The parents were also really pleased - I've passed on your details! Thank you again and again. KS

Perfect! Very professional communication, managed to get softplay hired despite the very short notice. Zara has been very helpful and even tried to move clients around to ensure that we'll receive the equipment on time and have it picked up on time esp that our event was at a venue with sepcific booking time! The equipment we received was clean and in very good condition. It helped keeping the little ones entertained throughout the birthday party. Thanks Dancing Cubs team for a wonderful experience!

I can't fault Dancing Cubs at all. From start to finish the service was fantastic!! Prompt, personal and informative email contact; the play equipment was delivered and collected on time, clean and in great condition. We were even provided anti-bac spray to be able to wipe down the equipment throughout the day if needed. I will 10000000% hire their equipment again and recommend to all my friends. :-)

I can't thanks Lopez and Dancing cubs enough. I hired Dancing Cubs for my son's first birthday and they were brilliant from beginning to end.
Lopez was friendly, approachable and very accommodating. My postcode wasn't on the booking page and she added it to the boooking form.
The website is clear and easy to navigate, very user friendly. Booking, payment and deposit refund was very efficient.
I hired a bouncy castle, ball pit and toy selection B. All of the toys were in excellent condition and very clean.
On the day,  there was a minor hiccup with the venue not being opened when they arrived to set up, but Lopez was efficient and got everything set up in time and did it with a cheerful smile!
The kids enjoyed all the toys and the parents were singing praises,
I would definitely recommend Dancing cubs and will use them again for future events.
Please don't hesitate to book with Dancing Cubs, they will deliver above and beyond, excellent service!

We had the most amazing birthday thanks to Dancing Cubs for my 2 year old! The delivery and pick up were so quick and professionally handled. All the kids adored the play package items. customer service was also very good.

Zara was absolutely helpful and accommodating, the guys who delivered the soft play were so so nice and efficient.
The soft play was clean and in PERFECT condition, we absolutely will be using again

What a great service from the whole team, from customer service and booking to the delivery team. The delivery team were bang on time for delivery and collection and were super friendly. The customer service team were really informative and addressed all my questions. The toys I hired was a huge hit and I will definitely be using Dancing Cubs again and hire two rollercoaster as it was a huge hit. Both the children and the adults enjoyed the didicars and it made my son's birthday party that extra bit special for him. Thank you so much guys.

Extremely helpful and polite staff plus great kit!
I'd highly recommend this company for their soft play toys.  We rented the following:  BALL POND, ROLLER COASTER, BIKES and BUILDING BLOCKS.
The party was a huge success and every communication with the team was perfect from ordering online, email communication and meeting the guys at delivery and pick up.
Thank you Dancing Cubs for making the party a success and making my life that little bit easier with your professionalism and assistance!

Provided a fantastic service for my sons Christening. The softplay was clean, well laid out and efficiently delivered in quite a tricky part of London. I can’t rate Zara and her team highly enough. The kids loved the softplay and it made the so much more enjoyable for those guests with small children. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Dancing Cubs again!

Hired a soft play package for our daughter's 2nd birthday. Dancing Cubs were amazing from start to finish! Very prompt communication from Zara and the team who responded to every question I had quickly. They also had extremely professional delivery staff who were on time for delivery and pick up. I will be using them every year!

A great selection of kids play equipment to rent at an extremely competitive price. We rented a range of items for our son's birthday party, and everything was in great clean condition, delivered and picked up timely as pre-agreed, and all communication and interaction has been extremely professional and friendly.
We very highly recommend Dancing Cubs and would happily use them in the future.

My kid and kids of friends of family had a great time wiry this on his first birthday.
Set up and pick up we’re just perfect! Would use again!

Absolutely adorable soft play! Everyone was impressed. This company did extraordinary things for me. They arrived earlier than expected and picked up soft play only next day!!! Moreover, I wanted to book Farmed Theme package but it was not available, so I purchased another package and they were so kind that gave me Farm Tractor complimentary on top of my package!!! So grateful. My son was over the moon!!
Totally recommend!
And also, the soft elements are in very good condition. Neat and clean

Excellent soft play company with top quality play mats & ball ponds. I have used them twice for my children’s birthdays and have been super pleased with the products and service. The team always arrive on time and expertly set up the area. They also come back on time to dismantle it all. All the children (from ages 9months- 9 years) loved the circus theme soft play at my sons birthday. I would highly recommend Dancing Cubs.

Lola and her little friends had an awesome time in the ball pit we hired for her 1st bday party.
We had a little get together with friends at a pub and the small ball pit was a great way to keep the children entertained in an environment where they would have typically got bored.
It’s also a great backdrop for some fun pics to remember a special occasion.
The team at Dancing cubs were punctual with delivery and pick up and a pleasure to deal with. Thank you!! See you at the next party!

Brilliant service by the team at Dancing Cubs. Our booking was smooth from start to finish, from the booking process to delivery and then finally collection. Their equipment was also a major hit with the children which is always great. Will certainly use their service again and highly recommended.

We hired two of the rollercoaster things and some cars for my daughter’s 3rd birthday and they were brilliant - such fun for the kids. Booking and communication was seemless and the team were super friendly and helpful. Our delivery guy was also really amazing. Highly recommend this company for all your kids party needs - I’ll definitely use again.

Needed last minute soft play equipment on a Bank Holiday. Called to arrange hire for Monday on the Sunday and the team were very accommodating. They were able to arrange a drop off and pick up time that suited me, they were prompt and sure to check that we were happy with set up before they left.
On collection, they were considerate to remove pieces of the soft play set around the children and allow them to play for as long as possible.
I would definitely use Dancing Cubs again.

Agree with the other comments that the website info seems a little fierce, but I guess this avoids lots of problems and our experience was that Dancing Cubs were incredibly helpful, great at communicating, the equipment was delivered and collected exactly on time – and all our little ones loved it. We will definitely be using them again. If you're having a party for 3-4 year olds can recommend the large lego bricks, they were a great success (we got two sets), and we also had the little bouncy castle. Perfect.

Hired a soft play package and ball pond for my sons first birthday party all the kids enjoyed it. Recieved an great service from Zara and the delivery and collection team. Very professional, would definitely hire from them again.

The support from Dancing Cubs for our event was brilliant. The service pre-event was efficient and responsive and really helpful - there are loads of different options and packages to make sure you get exactly what you need. The service on the day was equally efficient with the delivery guy going above and beyond to get it all set out and packed away again. The play park went down so well with all the kids - will definitely be using Dancing Cubs again!

Dancing cubs supplied the soft play Violet package and ball pit for my son's first birthday party - they arrived on time and everything was easy to assemble with their help and pack up was also stress free. The kids had a fantastic time in the area and I will definitely be using them again for future  parties! Thank you

Had a great experience booking with Dancing Cubs the perfect sized bouncy castle for our venue at very short notice. The team went above and beyond to make sure it got delivered and installed, despite being extremely busy with other bookings and deliveries. The staff were extremely professional and friendly and had a can-do attitude that is rare to find these days. Would definitely recommend Dancing Cubs and will certainly always use them in the future!

We used Dancing Cubs for our sons 3rd birthday and the service from booking to collection was absolutely spot on and took a whole heap of pressure from us for the special day. Will 100% use them again and can't recommend them enough.

Dancing Cubs were very professional and I would highly recommend their service. Their commuication and time-keeping was faultless and the set up was brilliant. Having shopped around beforehand, their products and prices were some of their best as well. I look forward to using them again next year.
Very pleasant experience. Booking was a breeze and was delivered and collected without issue! Kids had a great time! Would definitely use again!

Thanks to Dancing Cubs for the excellent service I received when booking the toddlers soft play ground. They arrived well before the party and magically transformed an open space into a kids dream playground. The kiddies had an absolute ball playing on the playground and the mom's were in heaven cause they could sit back and relax for a while. I think it's safe to say that the playground was the highlight of Simon's party. And the best part is it was really affordable. Thanks again Zara and all your team, we will be back for the next party. We high recommend Dancing Cubs to all mom's and dad's planning parties!

Fantastic service from dancing cubs. Zara talked me through my options and advised me what package to go for. I asked for specific soft play animals and they were able to deliver this for me so it was inkeeping with my theme. Delivery was on time and very professional as well as collection. Play equipment was clean and well kept. Will definatly use again and can highly recommend

We used Dancing Cubs to hire a Ball Pond for a first birthday party.  It was a great success with all the children.  This was ordered at short notice, and we found Zara very helpful and efficient.  Her colleague
delivered the ball pond on time, and collected it at the end of the party.  A very nice group to deal with, and we.vwould strongly recommend.
We used Dancing Cubs to hire a ball pond and soft play for our daughter's birthday party. Everything was great and delivery and pick up were on time. Very easy to deal with as well. Recommended!

Such a great company! The staff were quick to respond and very accommodating. On the day of the party the guys who set up were so helpful and cheerful - such a pleasure to deal with. The equipment itself was excellent - my kids and their friends loved it.

A very professional and friendly service, the play equipment was of good quality and condition, staff were very friendly and delivery plus collection was just as we had requested. Overall an excellent experience and would highly recommend. My son's 2nd birthday would not have been the same without it, both him and his guest had an amazing time and were thoroughly entertained!

I've used these guys a couple of times and have been very pleased about how professional they were, extremely helpful and very efficient.  First time I hired a bunch of random soft play toys and then a bouncy castle. Both times the people I spoke to on the phone were very helpful and the guys that dropped off and picked up were very friendly.
I would highly recommend Dancing Cubs.

We used Dancing Cubs to hire the jungle ballpit for our son's third birthday, and from the first contact to delivery to pick up everything was perfect. The website was so easy to navigate, we got all the details of the ball pond easily, and Zara was very helpful with more information. She was regularly in touch. Matt who did the delivery and pick up was very professional. Clean and sturdy equipment, exactly as photographed, and lots of fun for everyone! We will definitely be using again. Thanks Dancing Cubs team!

My son had a great party with the farm soft play from Dancing Cubs. Staff who turned up were on time to drop off and collect (no mean feat with the petrol problems across north london over the weekend) and couldn't have been nicer. Helped talking through the best set up for the equipment. Would recommend.

I hired a ball pit for my daughter’s 1st birthday and it was a great hit with the kids. The staff were friendly and patient when setting up and collecting the equipment. I’d definitely use Dancing Cubs again

Large selection of ball pits; seamless booking process; responsive, helpful, friendly and punctual staff - both when confirming certain booking details and for the drop-off and pick-up.  Excellent experience all round.

Dancing cubs were totally reliable and gave us good advice about what soft play we could fit into the space that we had. They turned up on time to drop off and pick up the items. It was all clean and well looked after. The staff were friendly and helpful. Thank you!

This is the second year in a row that we have used Dancing Cubs and we will definitely be back again next year - the ball pool was in a really good condition, was delivered on time at a time that suited us and the children absolutely loved it. A great company to use, thanks again for all your help Lopez.

I hired a play park and the children throughly enjoyed it! The delivery guys were very professional they arrived early to set up and collection was on time. The delivery guys were friendly and set up time didn't take that long either. The level of communication for hiring the equipment and after was very efficient. Would definitely be using them again for future events.

I hired their soft play for my son's first birthday party and it worked just perfectly the kids had load of fun. The soft play was bigger and nicer than it looked on the website and people were very professional and helpful. I will definitely hire it again for the next birthday!

I hired a selection of items for my daughters 3rd birthday, I still can't quite believe the level of service I received considering the great value of the dancing cubs equipment.
I spoke with one employee called Lopez throughout the transaction, she gave me a considerable amount of advise as I hadn't  arranged a kids party before, she dealt with a large number of last minute requests and was even there to install the equipment and with a smile on her face she agreed to move the ball pond after filling it with balls. The equipment arrived in great condition and the level of enjoyment from the kids was mind blowing. 20 x 2- 3year olds were entertained for 3 hours with no tears! The delivery and collection were punctual and swift. so very grateful to the team, highly recommend them. Thank you.

Fantastic service and a really friendly team. I ordered 14000 balls for my birthday party and it was by far the best party I've ever had. The balls were clean; delivery and collection were prompt; they very kindly moved them to where I wanted them in the house; and the price was very reasonable. And they also sent a follow up email to check everything was good and that I had a good party! Would absolutely reccommend.
The soft play was brilliant! The kids loved it, it was delivered on time and without any problems and picked up the same way. Very friendly people as well! Would recommend!

We hired a small soft play package and ball pond for a christening party. Great & courteous communication from the outset. On the day itself delivery and pick up was punctual and efficient (one less thing to worry about!). The soft play itself went down a storm - we had children playing aged from 9 months to 11 years old - and was clean and in good condition. I'll definitely be hiring from these guys again.

We booked the mini bouncy castle for our daughters 4th birthday party and had it in the garden. The communication before, during and after was exemplary. Delivery and pick up were punctual, quick and easy. Most importantly, the kids had an absolute ball. Would highly recommend Dancing Cubs to anyone considering using them. Thanks again team! x

Dancing cubs were truly fabulous for our baby's first birthday party! They were helpful and flexible in advance when discussing the right package for the day. They were prompt at both delivery and collection, and assembled everything themselves very flexible to adapt to the space available. They were fun and helpful, and made us feel completely at ease for the party. The soft play and ball bond were also thoroughly enjoyed by all the children ranging from 6 months to 7 years. Adults also had fun too! Thanks for a great party.

Hired from Dancing Cubs back in 2013 for my eldest son's birthday and did it again this year for my baby's first birthday as they were the only ones who had lots of items to match our jungle theme. The entire jungle play area was a huge hit and the highlight of our party!
Communication was great from initial enquiry, all the way through to post event. Clean, well kept equipment and prompt delivery and collection with a smile. The birthday messages are a nice touch :) can't recommend them enough!

Excellent service from start to finish. I called at first as I didn't really know what I needed and all communication and advice was  brilliant.
Delivery was early, I had the pond ball pool. It was clean, even the balls!!
The guys  came to pick it up on time and were patient, even though my son didn't want the fun to end!!
All in all a service I would definitely recommend and use again.
I look forward to using you again next year.

We booked Dancing Cubs for a joint 4th Birthday party and it was a total success, the kids absolutely loved it. So simple to organise and book and the service was both excellent and friendly from beginning to end and Zara was ever so accommodating. Thank you again.

I hired a ball pit and slide for my daughter’s birthday and found the company excellent. Straightforward to book, very reliable and kind to deal with. The equipment was clean and good quality. Definitely worth it.

Such great service, everyone is so polite and helpful! The equipment is great, clean and lots of fun for the kids! The guys came to collect and were very quick so we didn't have to hang around too long which is good when you have a wiped out toddler that wants their bed! Very impressed and would definitely recommend! :)

Such a brilliant company! Have used them twice now. The play equipment is clean, fun and in great condition. The team work really hard to fit to your schedule and meet your demands. Most importantly the kids love it.

So pleased with the package we got. (Lavender) hired it for my 3 year olds party and it was such a hit for everyone. The kids loved it!! Such value for money. My son and his friends had a great time!! Thank you Dancing Cubs, See you next year!

Absolute pleasure from the first phone call to the last email. Very helpful, organised and great equipment. Zara helped me through every challenge and the delivery staff were so helpful and positive absolute joy . I would recommend Dancing clubs to any parent out there looking for a reliable fun experience. I'll be using you for every future baby and family and friends thank you . :)
Leo's mummy
Sara xxx

We hired a ball pit, soft play toys and the rollercoaster and all of the toys were clean and looked great. There was great communication and the delivery was within plenty of time for the party. I would definitely recommend.

I hired a white package for my 2 years old daughter' birthday. Lopez recommended the package and it offered a really good value : 1 slide, 1 low roller coaster slide which was the most popular among 7 toddlers, 2 giant cars, 4 bikes/horses. Lopez really knows what kids will like based on experience. What I like the most about dancing cubs is honesty- when I chose an extra slide without knowing the package offers one, I was asked if I really want an additional slide!   The soft play look really clean and well looked after and we don't have to worry about cleaning them before our children give a go.
We will definitely use them again and recommend to any one.
